# Route query parameters named like a day that are not yet judged as one (POST-A-380, the query-string half), one `file::function.parameter` per line, sorted.
# SHRINK-ONLY: see tests/test_a_date_in_a_query_string_is_a_real_day_or_is_on_the_frozen_list.py. Pass the parameter to core.query_day.query_day in the handler (after the caller's
# access to what the route acts on is asked) and delete its line here in the same commit. Do not add a line to make a new parameter pass.
# First written 13-11-2026 after the manual-run doors (recurring bills, journals, fee billing, invoices) were judged. Seven parameters declared with a plain default and no Query(...) were added the same day, when an independent read showed the first scan could not see them; the scan reads every query parameter now.
